internal_error: Something went wrong on the server. Reference for troubleshooting: {{request_id}}
not_found: This does not exist, or not any more.
csrf_header_missing: The request did not come from the nexcrate interface and was refused.
username_invalid: The username must not be empty and may have at most 64 characters.
password_too_short: The password needs at least {{min}} characters.
login_throttled: Too many failed attempts. Please wait {{retry_after}} seconds.
log_mode_invalid: This log level or duration does not exist.
log_mode_fixed: The log level is fixed by NEXCRATE_LOG_LEVEL and cannot be changed here.
method_not_allowed: This address does not accept this kind of request.
server_unreachable: The nexcrate server does not answer. Is it still running?
version_label_taken: A version with this name already exists for this type.
version_in_use: This version is still in use: by {{sources}} connections and {{titles}} titles.
version_taken: This version already gets its data from another connection.
app_unsupported: This app is not supported yet.
import_running: An import is already running for this connection.
radarr_unreachable: Radarr cannot be reached at {{url}}. Are address and port right?
radarr_timeout: Radarr did not answer in time.
radarr_key_rejected: Radarr did not accept the API key. Is Sonarr or another app answering at this address? That looks exactly the same.
radarr_not_radarr: Something answers at this address, but it is not Radarr.
sonarr_unreachable: Sonarr cannot be reached at {{url}}. Are address and port right?
sonarr_timeout: Sonarr did not answer in time.
sonarr_key_rejected: Sonarr did not accept the API key. Is Radarr or another app answering at this address? That looks exactly the same.
sonarr_not_sonarr: Something answers at this address, but it is not Sonarr.
sonarr_too_old: nexcrate needs Sonarr 4 or later. This one runs {{version}}.
source_app_unsupported: This works with Radarr connections only, not yet with Sonarr.
source_app_locked: The app of a connection cannot change. Delete it and add a new one.
source_version_locked: This Sonarr connection already fills its version. Delete it and add it again to fill another version.
poster_missing: There is no image for this title.
source_url_invalid: This address does not work. It has to start with http:// or https:// and must not contain a user name or password.
source_key_missing: The stored API key of this connection cannot be read. Please enter it again.
version_kind_mismatch: This version belongs to another type. Movies and Radarr need a movie version, series and Sonarr a series version.
import_interrupted: The import was interrupted because nexcrate restarted. The next import runs on its own.
import_failed: The import failed unexpectedly. The log has the details.
tmdb_not_configured: No TMDB token is stored yet. Add your API Read Access Token under Settings, Online services.
tmdb_token_unreadable: The stored TMDB token cannot be read. Please enter it again.
tmdb_token_rejected: TMDB did not accept the token. Use the API Read Access Token, not the API key.
tmdb_rate_limited: TMDB receives too many requests right now. Please try again shortly.
tmdb_unavailable: TMDB is not available right now. Please try again later.
tmdb_timeout: TMDB did not answer in time.
tmdb_unreachable: TMDB cannot be reached. Is this server connected to the internet?
title_exists: This movie is already in your library.
version_owned_by_source: This version comes from a Radarr connection. It goes when you remove the movie there or delete the connection.
title_has_source_versions: Your own versions are removed. The versions from Radarr stay until you remove the movie there or delete the connection.
indexer_key_rejected: The indexer did not accept the API key.
indexer_limit_reached: The request limit of the indexer is reached. nexcrate asks again in {{retry_after}} seconds.
indexer_not_newznab: Something answers at this address, but not a Newznab or Torznab indexer. Is the path right, for example /api at the end?
indexer_wrong_kind: The answer does not fit the chosen kind: Newznab is for Usenet, Torznab for torrents. Choose the other kind.
indexer_unreachable: The indexer cannot be reached at {{url}}. Are address and port right?
indexer_timeout: The indexer did not answer in time.
indexer_answer_too_large: The answer of the indexer is larger than 10 MB and was refused.
indexer_url_invalid: This address does not work. It has to start with http:// or https:// and must contain neither a user name and password nor the key.
indexer_key_missing: The stored API key of this indexer cannot be read. Please enter it again.
indexer_unsupported: This indexer is neither Newznab nor Torznab. nexcrate cannot take it over.
indexer_exists: An indexer with this address exists already.
indexer_categories_empty: This indexer returns nothing in the chosen categories right now. Are the categories right? You can save anyway.
indexer_kind_locked: The kind of a saved indexer cannot change. Add a new indexer for the other kind.
profile_kind_unsupported: Profiles for this type are not there yet. They come in a later step.
custom_format_in_use: A profile still points at this format. Take it out there first.
custom_format_name_taken: A format of this name is already there.
profile_name_taken: A profile of this name is already there.
profile_in_use: A version still judges by this profile.
profile_missing: This version has no profile yet. The assistant makes one.
profile_answers_invalid: Some answers do not fit the questions. Reload the questions and try again.
profile_import_invalid: This file cannot be taken over as a nexcrate profile ({{reason}}).
profile_build_failed: This profile cannot be built with the current TRaSH Guides state. The log names the missing part.
trash_update_breaks: The new TRaSH Guides state could not build these profiles any more: {{versions}}. The current state stays.
trash_unreachable: GitHub cannot be reached right now. The TRaSH Guides state stays as it is.
trash_update_invalid: The download from GitHub is not a usable TRaSH Guides state. Nothing was changed.
search_running: A search is already running for this title.
album_no_artist: This album has no artist in the library, so it cannot be searched.
search_busy: Too many searches are running at the same time. Please wait until one of them is done.
no_indexers: No indexer is switched on. Add one or switch one on under Settings, Indexers.
client_not_found: This download client does not exist, or not any more.
client_unreachable: The download client cannot be reached at {{url}}. Are address and port right?
client_auth_failed: The download client did not accept the credentials. SABnzbd needs its API key, not the NZB key.
client_host_refused: SABnzbd refused the host name nexcrate used. Add that name to the host whitelist in SABnzbd, or use the address.
client_wrong_kind: Something answers at this address, but not the chosen download client.
client_category_failed: The category {{category}} could not be created or used in the download client.
client_category_unusable: SABnzbd handles this category in a way nexcrate cannot follow. Switch job folders on and sorting off for the category in SABnzbd.
client_in_use: This download client still has downloads of nexcrate that are not finished.
client_kind_locked: The kind of a saved download client cannot change. Add a new download client for another kind.
client_invalid: Name, address or category are not valid. A category may only use lower case letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens.
client_refused: The download client refused the release.
search_expired: This search is not kept any more. Please search again.
release_not_found: This search has no such release of the movie.
version_fed_by_source: This version comes from a Radarr or Sonarr connection. Change it there; nexcrate does not load for it.
series_fed_by_source: The Sonarr connection that feeds this series decides its type. Change it there, or the next run takes it back.
version_no_profile: This version has no profile yet.
version_no_folder: This version has no default folder yet. Choose one under Settings, Folders and naming.
no_client_for_protocol: No switched on download client loads this kind of release.
no_client_for_tags: No download client fits the tags of this title. Give one of its tags to a client, or keep one without tags.
auto_tag_name_taken: A rule of this kind is called {{name}} already.
download_active: A download is already running for this version.
release_not_fitting: This release does not fit the profile of the version.
release_blocklisted: This release is on the blocklist of the title.
release_fetch_failed: The release file could not be fetched from the indexer.
release_file_invalid: The indexer did not deliver a usable NZB or torrent file.
download_finished: This download is filed away already, or right now, and cannot be removed from the download client.
download_not_retryable: Only a download with a problem, or one waiting to be filed away, can be tried again.
download_not_failed: Only a failed download can be taken off the problems.
mapping_not_proposed: There is no proposed path for this download to confirm.
download_not_found: This download does not exist, or not any more.
folder_not_visible: nexcrate does not see this folder. Only folders mounted into the container can be chosen.
folder_not_writable: nexcrate cannot write into this folder. Please check the rights of the mount.
folder_in_use: This folder is already the default folder of the version {{label}}, or lies inside or around it.
naming_pattern_empty: A naming pattern must not be empty.
naming_pattern_incomplete: The pattern is incomplete. It needs a title token, and a file name also needs {Release Year} or {Original Title}.
naming_token_not_in_folder: The token {{token}} comes from the file and cannot name a folder.
waiting_release_not_found: This release does not wait any more: it was loaded or taken off.
blocklist_entry_not_found: This blocklist entry does not exist, or not any more.
title_download_active: Downloads of this title are still running ({{count}}). Remove them together with the title, or wait until they are done.
version_download_active: Downloads of the version {{label}} are still running ({{count}}). Remove them together with the version, or wait until they are done.
source_taken_over: This connection was taken over. nexcrate no longer reads it.
takeover_running: A check or takeover is already running for this connection.
takeover_mapping_invalid: The mapping for {{remote}} does not work. Radarr's path must be complete and given only once, and nexcrate must see the chosen folder.
takeover_needs_import: Radarr does not answer right now, and nexcrate does not know Radarr's movie folders yet. Switch Radarr on once more, then try again.
takeover_root_unmapped: The folder {{remote}} from Radarr has no matching folder in nexcrate yet. Please choose it.
takeover_files_missing: nexcrate did not find {{count}} files from Radarr. Confirm that these movies count as missing afterwards.
takeover_queue_active: Radarr is still loading {{count}} downloads for these movies. Wait until Radarr has filed them away, or confirm that nexcrate takes over without them.
takeover_failed: The takeover failed unexpectedly. Nothing was changed. The log has the details.
naming_modifier_unsupported: In the token {{token}} only a number that shortens may follow the colon.
source_not_taken_over: This connection is not taken over, so there is nothing to undo.
takeover_downloads_active: nexcrate is still loading {{count}} downloads for this version. Let them finish or remove them, then undo the takeover.
nothing_wanted: There is nothing to search for this title right now.
root_not_removable: This folder cannot be removed: it belongs to a version. Only folders you added yourself can be removed.
disk_job_running: nexcrate is scanning folders or restoring movies right now. Wait until that has finished.
folder_changed: The folder is no longer as nexcrate scanned it. Scan the folder again.
folder_known: This folder now belongs to a movie in the library or to Radarr.
version_has_file: This version already has a file: {{location}}. nexcrate replaces nothing.
companions_off: Writing companion files is switched off. Switch it on under Folders and naming.
companion_job_running: nexcrate is checking or filling in companion files right now. Wait until that has finished.
companion_not_replaceable: nexcrate cannot replace this release.nex. Replacing works only for a foreign, broken, newer, hand-changed file or one written by another installation.
episode_group_unavailable: TMDB does not deliver this episode group right now. Please try again later.
anime_later: nexcrate does not search anime yet.
assignment_not_better: A chosen file is not better than the file the episode has: {{episodes}}.
download_files_changed: A file of this download is gone or changed. Please open it again.
download_not_assignable: No file of this download waits for an assignment.
download_not_choosable: No video of this download waits for a choice.
episode_not_in_series: An episode does not belong to this series.
episode_twice: An episode is chosen for more than one file.
episodes_downloading: A running download of this version already loads episodes of this release: {{episodes}}.
nothing_to_take: The search would take nothing for this version.
release_no_episodes: This release holds no episode the version monitors.
release_no_gain: This release neither fills nor replaces an episode of this version.
download_busy: nexcrate is still working on this download. Try again in a moment.
assignment_covers_more: The file there also holds {{episodes}}. Choose those episodes as well, or the file stays as it is.
episode_has_file: This episode already has a file in this version. Choose an episode without a file.
file_has_episodes: This file holds episodes. Take its episodes away first, then it can be left out.
version_has_files: This version already has a series folder. A second assignment would replace it.
lidarr_unreachable: Lidarr cannot be reached at {{url}}. Are address and port right?
lidarr_timeout: Lidarr did not answer in time.
lidarr_key_rejected: Lidarr did not accept the API key. Is another app answering at this address? That looks exactly the same.
lidarr_not_lidarr: Something answers at this address, but it is not Lidarr.
lidarr_too_old: nexcrate needs Lidarr 2 or later. This one runs {{version}}.
musicbrainz_disabled: MusicBrainz is switched off under Settings, Privacy.
musicbrainz_busy: MusicBrainz is busy right now. Please try again shortly.
musicbrainz_unavailable: MusicBrainz is not available at the moment.
musicbrainz_timeout: MusicBrainz did not answer in time.
musicbrainz_unreachable: MusicBrainz cannot be reached. Is this server connected to the internet?
musicbrainz_not_found: MusicBrainz does not know this entry, or not any more.
musicbrainz_bad_answer: MusicBrainz sent an answer nexcrate cannot read.
music_version_exists: Music has one version; a second one cannot be added yet.
album_fed_by_source: This album is watched in Lidarr; change it there.
album_folder_missing: The album folder cannot be seen.
album_without_files: This album has no files nexcrate filed.
release_fixed: Files of this download lie in the album folder already; the release stays.
release_not_of_album: This release does not belong to this album.
track_not_in_release: A track does not belong to the chosen release.
track_twice: A track is chosen for more than one file.
acoustid_key_invalid: AcoustID does not know this key. Use the API key of an application (My applications), not the one of your account.
acoustid_unreachable: acoustid.org cannot be reached; the key is not stored. Try again later.
acoustid_error: AcoustID answered with an error; the key is not stored.
acoustid_no_key: No AcoustID key is stored, and none is shipped.
track_not_in_album: This track is not part of the album.
track_has_file: This track has a file already.
album_folder_known: This folder belongs to an album of the library or to Lidarr by now.
album_has_folder: This album has a folder with files already.
album_not_in_library: Add the album the release.nex names first.
rename_running: A rename, or the check of the release.nex files, is running. Please wait until it is done.
rename_nothing_to_undo: There is no run nexcrate can take back.
mediaserver_not_found: This media server does not exist, or not any more.
mediaserver_invalid: Name, address or a path mapping are not valid. The address starts with http:// or https:// and carries neither user name nor password.
mediaserver_kind_locked: The kind of a saved media server cannot change. Add a new media server for another kind.
mediaserver_unreachable: The media server cannot be reached at {{url}}. Are address and port right?
mediaserver_auth_failed: The media server did not accept the token or API key. Is another server than the chosen one running at the address?
mediaserver_wrong_kind: Something answers at this address, but not the chosen media server.
mediaserver_http_error: The media server reports an error (HTTP {{status}}).
plextv_unreachable: plex.tv cannot be reached. You can also type the token in by hand.
plextv_error: plex.tv gave an answer nexcrate cannot use. You can also type the token in by hand.
plextv_server_unknown: This server is not among the servers plex.tv listed for the sign-in.
plextv_pin_unclaimed: This sign-in at plex.tv is not confirmed, or it has expired. Please start it again.
api_key_missing: This address needs a key in the header Authorization: Bearer.
api_key_invalid: This key is unknown or was revoked.
api_key_name_invalid: A key needs a name of 1 to {{max}} characters.
api_key_scopes_invalid: A key needs at least one scope.
api_key_name_taken: Another key already has this name.
api_key_limit: There are {{max}} keys already. Revoke one nobody needs first.
api_key_not_found: This key does not exist, or not any more.
kind_unsupported: This nexcrate does not answer for the kind {{kind}}.
ref_source_unknown: A title of the kind {{kind}} cannot be asked by this source.
ref_ambiguous: Several titles carry this reference. Please ask by the TMDB number.
title_not_found: nexcrate does not have this title.
marker_too_old: This change marker is too old. Fetch the library again from 0.
download_importing: A download of this version is being filed away right now. Delete the files once it is done.
episode_not_found: The series has no episode {{episode}} in season {{season}}.
recycle_file_gone: The file is no longer in the recycle bin.
recycle_slot_taken: The version or episode has another file by now. The deleted one stays in the recycle bin.
recycle_target_taken: Something else lies where the file was. It stays in the recycle bin.
recycle_title_gone: The title or its version is no longer in the library. The file cannot go back.
ref_not_addable: nexcrate adds a new title only by its TMDB number.
scope_not_for_kind: Only a series has seasons and episodes.
version_not_found: The title does not have this version.
version_unknown: nexcrate has no version with this id.
action_not_allowed: This is not possible with the download as it stands.
too_many_streams: This key already holds as many open event streams as it may ({{limit}}).
imdb_unknown: nexcrate knows no IMDb number for this title.
omdb_key_invalid: OMDb does not know this key.
omdb_limit: This OMDb key used up its requests for today.
omdb_unreachable: OMDb did not answer; the key is not stored.
pairing_limit: Too many programs are waiting to be connected right now. Please try again later.
pairing_not_found: This request to connect no longer exists.
rate_limited: This key sent too many requests. Again in {{retry_after}} seconds.
track_not_found: The album has no such track.
version_not_available: nexcrate has no such version; there is no music version yet.
foreign_same_release: This version has exactly this release already. Remove the job.
foreign_job_failed: The download client gave up on this job. Remove it.
foreign_no_version: The series does not have this version. Add it to the series first.
foreign_no_episodes: nexcrate knows no episodes of this series yet.
indexer_anime_categories_empty: This indexer returns nothing in the chosen anime categories right now. Are the categories right? You can save anyway.
series_type_run_running: TMDB is being asked already. Please wait for it.
backup_failed: The backup could not be made. The log names the reason.
backup_not_found: This backup does not exist, or not any more.
backup_password_short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
restore_too_large: The archive is larger than 4 GB.
restore_not_an_archive: This file is no valid archive.
restore_not_a_backup: This archive holds no nexcrate backup.
restore_wrong_password: The password does not fit this archive.
restore_not_a_database: The file in the archive is no database.
restore_backup_newer: This backup comes from a newer version than the running nexcrate.
restore_unknown_version: This backup does not say which version it comes from.
notify_url_invalid: The address has to start with http:// or https://.
notify_auth_rejected: {{host}} refused the sign-in (HTTP {{status}}). Check the credentials.
notify_not_found: {{host}} does not know this address (HTTP 404). Check address and path.
notify_unreachable: {{host}} cannot be reached. Is the service running, is the port right?
notify_bad_answer: {{host}} gave no answer nexcrate can read.
apprise_no_config: Apprise holds no configuration under this key.
apprise_partial: Apprise could not deliver to at least one of its services.
mail_tls: The encrypted connection to the mail server failed. Does the encryption fit the port? 587 is mostly STARTTLS, 465 mostly SSL.
mail_refused: {{host}}:{{port}} takes no connection. Is the port right?
mail_unreachable: The mail server {{host}}:{{port}} cannot be reached.
mail_auth: The mail server refused the sign-in. Are user name and password right?
mail_recipient_refused: The mail server refused the recipient.
mail_sender_refused: The mail server refused the sender address. Many providers want it to belong to the signed-in account.
mail_rejected: The mail server refused the mail.
mail_address_invalid: This is no valid e-mail address.
notify_target_not_found: This notification target does not exist any more.
notify_not_confirmed: Send a test message first and type its code, then it can be saved.
notify_code_missing: There is no code yet. Send a test message first.
notify_code_too_many: Too many wrong tries. Send a new test message.
folder_rules_not_for_kind: Music has no library rules, only movies and series do.
client_address_refused: The download client refuses nexcrate's address. Add it to rpc-whitelist in Transmission or switch the list off.
